sentences.text: It is the submission of counsel for appellants that trial Court erred in convicting and awarding jail sentence to present appellant.
He suffered around four years and two months of incarceration as pre and post trial confinement.
Only source of implication of present appellant is a video (Ex.P.-42) in which present appellant appears to be committing the offence of rape over prosecutrix.
However, prosecutrix (PW-01) denied such allegation categorically.

No other prosecution witness,
including brother of prosecutrix (PW-04), supported the story of prosecution.
No DNA report was made available.
FIR was lodged after one and a half months of the alleged incident.
He has good case on merits and hearing of appeal shall take some time.
He undertakes to abide by the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.

Hence, considering the fact situation and the testimony of prosecutrix (PW-01) and other prosecution witnesses, present appellant be granted benefit of suspension of Mahendra Banjara vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52851325/

sentences.text: 4. Per contra, counsel for respondent/State opposed the application and prayed for its dismissal.
However, he fairly submits that prosecutrix (PW-01) and other prosecution witnesses did not support the story of prosecution.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the record.
6.

After considering the rival submissions raised by counsel for the parties, especially looking to the fact that prosecutrix (PW-01) as well as other prosecution witnesses did not support the story of prosecution and no DNA report is available to implicate present appellant, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this Court intends to allow the application of present appellant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail (I.A.No.9172/2025) but with certain stringent conditions.

7. If appellant No.2-Lakhan Banjara furnishes bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court that he shall appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 22/04/2026 and thereafter, on all other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Office for appearance, then he shall be released on bail and execution of jail sentence is suspended till disposal of this appeal, subject to deposit of fine amount.
8. I.A.No.9172/2025 stands disposed of, accordingly.
9.
Present appellant shall mark his presence before the concerned Police Station on first Sunday of every alternate month between 10:30 am to 2:00 pm for the next two years i.e. till December, 2027.
10. Present appellant shall not be source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant/victim side in any manner and he shall not move in their vicinity

;
otherwise, benefit of bail given today by way of suspension of sentence shall be withdrawn immediately.
11. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
12. Certified copy as per rules/directions.

(ANAND PATHAK) 
 JUDGE
(Dubey)
